facts.statement: Community Team Ambassadors held a kart racing community event called the Wildwood Racing Challenge at the Wildwood Speedway, with a party held just outside the race course.
facts.quote: we are gathering at the Wildwood Speedway, just south of the Crossroads Warpstone for some fast and furious kart racing action.

facts.statement: The Wildwood Racing Challenge ran on Server 1 on Thursday March 10, 2011 at 3pm Pacific Time for U.S. and Latin America players.
facts.quote: Thursday March 10th, 2011 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: A second Wildwood Racing Challenge session ran on Server 1 on Friday March 11, 2011 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) for UK and Europe players.
facts.quote: Friday March 11th, 2011 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com community event notice announcing an Ambassador-run kart racing event at the Wildwood Speedway, south of the Crossroads Warpstone, with a party outside the course. It ran on Server 1 on Thursday March 10, 2011 (3pm Pacific, US and Latin America) and Friday March 11, 2011 (9:00am Pacific / 4:00pm GMT, UK and Europe).
